about: Round-3 sourced examples for tests only. No answer-key file is written from these. Synthetic squares stand in for outlines that were not downloaded.

joint.park_or_area: Big Rivers Wildlife Management Area and State Forest (Union/Crittenden Co.)
joint.owners: KY Division of Forestry and KY Dept of Fish and Wildlife Resources (jointly acquired 6,732 acres)
joint.how_shown_in_gis: PAD-US/agency GIS representation: not verified. Not verified; see PAD-US dictionary notes.
joint.notes: Page says agencies 'jointly acquired'; does not say which agency manages which part. PAD-US 2.1 data dictionary (https://d9-wret.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/assets/palladium/production/s3fs-public/atoms/files/PADUS2_1_DataDictionary.pdf) read: Own_Type and Mang_Type have a 'Joint' category; Own_Name/Mang_Name text does not address joint arrangements; Mang_Name preferred for federal lands.

joint.park_or_area: Livingston County WMA and State Natural Area
joint.owners: KDFWR, KY State Nature Preserves Commission, Livingston County Fiscal Court (joint agreement)
joint.notes: Page text: owned and managed through a joint agreement; hosted on TNC site but TNC not stated as owner/manager. Good test for state + county + commission.

joint.park_or_area: Lake Cumberland WMA (shoreline surrounding Lake Cumberland)
joint.owners: Owned by US Army Corps of Engineers; hunting/fishing regs by KDFWR
joint.notes: Federal-owned land with state wildlife management role; the formal manager arrangement was NOT stated in the document. Adjacent separate areas: Beaver Creek, Buck Creek, R.F. Tarter, Meadow Creek WMAs; Lake Cumberland State Resort Park.

joint.park_or_area: Mill Creek Wildlife Management Area (Daniel Boone National Forest)
joint.owners: USFS (ownership not explicitly stated on page) cooperatively managed with KDFWR
joint.notes: Page: listed as recreation site within Daniel Boone NF; 'cooperatively managed with the Kentucky Department of Fish and Wildlife Resources'. Expect Own=USFS, Mang=USFS or State in PAD-US; not verified.

joint.park_or_area: Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve, National Marine Conservation Area Reserve and Haida Heritage Site
joint.owners: Government of Canada (Parks Canada, DFO) and Haida Nation (Council of the Haida Nation) via Archipelago Management Board
joint.notes: Page: board has equal number of members from Canada and Haida Nation; oversees park reserve, NMCA reserve and Haida Heritage Site. Three designations under one board.

joint.owners: Government of Canada and Government of Quebec (1990 agreement; federal Act and Quebec Act)
joint.notes: Federal Act s.2, 5, 6, 8-9, 15, 16: park established under 1990 federal-Quebec agreement; enlargement only over Quebec public lands; management plan prepared jointly. Zones Type I-IV mentioned (see nested file).
